processes.realtime_desk_procedure_instructions: Real-time desk lead distributes written procedures and rules (cuts, checkouts, bid tiering, swaps, counterparty changes) to shift traders, who must follow and apply them.
processes.realtime_congestion_revenue_reconciliati: Real-time desk notifies settlements of congestion/ISO revenue and reconciles volumes, prices and SAR/inc sheets against CAISO and settlement flashes, chasing and correcting discrepancies.
processes.desk_position_and_schedule_briefing: Desk lead briefs shift traders on daily length/short positions, new purchases, special schedules and services to be handled, requiring follow-up entry and calls.
processes.realtime_deal_import_correction: Correcting wrong import IDs, templates or load zones in deal/scheduling systems and confirming the fix with the ISO.
processes.realtime_shift_schedule_management: Managing shift swaps, schedule revisions and record keeping for the real-time desk.
